description.p: Drive as far as you can over endless, ever steeper hills. Keep an eye on the fuel gauge, collect coins, pull off flips and big air for bonuses, and spend your coins on upgrades, new vehicles and new stages.

ul.li: Six stages: Countryside, Desert, Arctic, Highlands, Moon and Mars
Five vehicles, each with four upgradeable parts
Real 2D physics with suspension, wheelies and air control
Online races with up to three friends on the same network

description.p: Online races with friends, and Easy / Medium / Hard difficulty levels.
